headline: Creative Identity, Digital Citizenship & Early Independence
summary: Practical advice for managing school-life balance, creative portfolios, first earnings, and supportive peer spaces.

advice.title: Automate First Paycheck Habits
advice.guidance: Whether from part-time work, tutoring, or gifts, setting aside 20% immediately makes larger tech or travel goals effortless.
advice.actionStep: Create one target fund for a skill-building tool or upcoming trip in Finance Goals.

advice.title: Protect Focus & Sleep Hygiene
advice.guidance: Batch social notifications and switch devices to Night Comfort 45 minutes before bed to boost energy and mood.
advice.actionStep: Set a consistent evening wind-down cue on school nights.

advice.title: Build a Positive Creator Footprint
advice.guidance: Curate projects—code, art, music, or volunteering—that showcase your real voice for future mentors and colleges.
advice.actionStep: Save your latest creative milestone in your Wondering World profile.
